title: Welcome home
narration: Penny's route links the garden, doorway, stairs and toy room.

title: A furnished world
narration: Five reusable primitives build the house, furniture and articulated toys.

title: Hierarchy in motion
narration: Jessie attaches to Bullseye's saddle; one parent transform moves both.

title: Flight, laser and collision
narration: Buzz aims at the obstacle. The nearest ray hit receives an impulse.

title: Rescue and return
narration: The car follows waypoints. Wheel rotation uses distance divided by radius.

title: Live character takeover
narration: Woody follows your controls while Jessie and Buzz continue the mission; 0 releases him, N enters full manual.

title: Directional, point and spot
narration: Moonlight is directional. The lamp adds a point source and a soft cone.

title: Gouraud shading
narration: Light is evaluated at vertices; the rasterizer interpolates the result.

title: Phong shading
narration: Interpolated normals are normalized; the reflection-vector highlight is per pixel.

title: Procedural textures
narration: UVs map grain, wallpaper, fabric and lunar craters onto shared geometry.

title: Ray tracing
narration: A BVH finds analytic hits; shadow rays and mirror bounces reveal the polished floor.

title: A quiet morning
narration: The lamp turns off, the toys return home and Penny falls asleep.
